summary: The Tamil Nadu government announced major developmental projects, including a ₹2,882-crore housing initiative and 50,000 free agricultural power connections. Heavy rainfall triggered red alerts and landslides in southern districts, while the state mourned the passing of culinary legend Chef Damu.

stories.headline: TN Announces ₹2,882 Crore Project to Build 12,648 New Houses
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government has approved a massive housing initiative for the state. A total of 12,648 new houses will be constructed across various regions at an estimated outlay of ₹2,882 crore.

stories.headline: IMD Issues Red Alert for 3 TN Districts Amid Heavy Rain and Slides
stories.summary: Continuous downpours triggered landslides on Kodaikanal roads and severed access to several villages. The weather department issued a red alert for Madurai, Theni, and Dindigul districts.

stories.headline: Padma Shri Awardee Chef Damu Passes Away at 72 in Chennai
stories.summary: Culinary icon and Guinness World Record holder Chef K. Damodaran passed away in Chennai due to health complications. Leaders and television personalities expressed condolences over his death.

stories.headline: TN Government Sanctions ₹750 Crore for 50,000 Farm Power Links
stories.summary: The state government issued an official order to provide 50,000 new free electricity connections to farmers. An amount of ₹750 crore has been sanctioned to execute the project.

stories.headline: Chennai MTC Wins National Award for Urban Transport Financing
stories.summary: The Metropolitan Transport Corporation in Chennai bagged a national award for its innovative urban transport financing initiatives. The recognition highlights municipal transit reforms in the state.

stories.headline: SRMIST to Host Semiconductor Summit 2026 in Chennai on Oct 27
stories.summary: SRMIST and The Hindu will conduct the Semiconductor Summit 2026 in Chennai on October 27. Industry experts, academics, and researchers will discuss India's chip technology ecosystem.

stories.headline: Pallikaranai Marshland Becomes Year-Round Habitat for Pelicans
stories.summary: Spot-billed pelicans have begun staying year-round at the Pallikaranai marshland in Chennai. Conservation efforts and steady water availability have supported bird populations in the urban wetland.

stories.headline: Chennai to Host 1st Chola Chess Open International Grandmasters Event
stories.summary: Chennai will play host to the inaugural Chola Chess Open International Grandmasters Tournament. Top international players and rising grandmasters are scheduled to participate in the championship.

stories.headline: TN Police Bust Multi-State Drug Ring, Key Suspect Arrested
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu police dismantled a major methamphetamine trafficking network spanning Delhi, Bengaluru, and Chennai. Officers arrested a key operative involved in transporting illicit drugs across state lines.

stories.headline: Onion Prices Touch ₹60 per Kg at Chennai’s Koyambedu Market
stories.summary: Wholesale onion prices surged again at the Koyambedu market in Chennai, touching ₹60 per kilogram. Supply disruptions from producing states led to the recent rise in retail costs.
